instructions:
# User Provisioning

Hand-crafted skill for SCIM 2.0 user provisioning.

## What this skill does

- Creates, reads, updates, and deletes users via SCIM
- Manages group membership for access control
- Supports the deactivation lifecycle (active flag)
- Lists and filters users with SCIM filter syntax

## When to use

- Wiring IdP-to-app provisioning (Okta, Azure AD)
- Building an internal directory sync client
- Auditing what a SCIM provider stores

## Real commands

```bash
# Create a user
curl -s -X POST 'https://scim.example.com/v2/Users' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"jdoe@example.com","active":true,"name":{"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"}}' | jq

# Deactivate (never delete)
curl -s -X PATCH 'https://scim.example.com/v2/Users/123' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":false}]}' | jq

# Filter users
curl -s 'https://scim.example.com/v2/Users?filter=userName+eq+%22jdoe%40example.com%22&startIndex=1&count=10' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' | jq

# Group with members
curl -s -X POST 'https://scim.example.com/v2/Groups' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],"displayName":"eng","members":[{"value":"123"}]}' | jq

# Delete (terminal)
curl -s -X DELETE 'https://scim.example.com/v2/Users/123' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}'
```

## Lifecycle

- create -> active=true
- suspend/deprovision -> active=false
- delete only for forgotten-account cleanup

## Testing

```bash
curl -s 'https://scim.example.com/v2/Users?filter=userName+eq+%22jdoe%40example.com%22' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' | jq '.totalResults'
curl -s 'https://scim.example.com/v2/ServiceProviderConfig' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' | jq
```

## Best practices

- Deactivate instead of delete for compliance history
- URL-encode filters; use startIndex/count for pagination
- Test against ServiceProviderConfig before CRUD
